diagrams.title: planner-hierarchy board — recursive decomposition and 3-goal status
diagrams.content:
flowchart TD
  spec["spec"] -->|"G2 project-planner (ready)"| features["features"]
  features -->|"G1 feature-planner (complete)"| goals["goals"]
  goals --> tasks["tasks"]
  g1["G1 feature-planner: feature to goals"] --> features
  g2["G2 project-planner: spec to features"] --> route["/comms/project/decompose route"]
  route --> features
  g2 --> t2["G2-T2 count_features_for_project"]
  t2 -->|"needs pre-split"| comms["comms_messages.py 389 of 400 lines"]
  g3["G3 prd-import: BMAD/PRD to goal-DAG"] -->|"Gap 1: no task DAG"| dag["G3 task DAG (missing)"]
  g3 --> import["planning/prd-import.md"]
  import -->|"posts to /comms/post"| goals
  route -.->|"blocks full integration"| g3
